title: SlimeyGUIS
description: new slimey themed resource pack still in BETA
body:
🟢 SlimeyGUI (Beta)
SlimeyGUI is a custom Minecraft Java Edition resource pack that gives all your inventory interfaces a gooey, slime-themed makeover! From chests to crafting tables, enjoy a playful, green-tinted style that adds a fun twist to your gameplay.

🧪 Beta Version
Only inventory GUIs are currently retextured. More updates are on the way!

✅ Features:
Slime-themed textures for inventory-based GUIs (chests, crafting, etc.)

Clean and consistent green design

Lightweight and easy to stack with other packs

🎮 Perfect for slime-themed worlds, green aesthetics, or just something new!
